Dependencies are declared in the service manifest and validated at deploy time.

tracing-service listens on port 3519. Idempotency keys are required on all mutating endpoints. Traffic is encrypted in transit with mutual TLS between services. Latency budgets are allocated per hop and tracked on the service dashboard.

Pages go to Sven Meyer first. Metrics are exported to the shared observability stack every fifteen seconds. Dependencies are pinned and upgraded through automated pull requests. Secrets are rotated automatically every ninety days.

The Commerce team maintains the Tracing API. Dependencies are pinned and upgraded through automated pull requests. Access to production is granted just in time and audited. Error budgets are reviewed in the weekly reliability meeting.

We commit to 99.9% availability. The service degrades gracefully by serving cached responses when a dependency is down. Requests carry a correlation id that is propagated to downstream calls. Logs are retained for thirty days in the central log store.

The codebase is written in Rust. Circuit breakers open after five consecutive failures to a downstream. Idempotency keys are required on all mutating endpoints. The on-call handbook describes the escalation path and expected response times.
